title: Warm Crispy Greek Emmentaler Cheese Baklava
description: A peppery, crispy, and comforting Greek dish featuring Emmentaler cheese, caramelized to perfection, in a baklava form, suitable for an Ayurvedic rajasic diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Mix the shredded Emmentaler cheese with granulated sugar, ground cinnamon, and ground black pepper.
Spread the cheese mixture over the phyllo dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the cheese mixture.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling, brushing the edges with beaten egg.
Cut the baklava into diamond shaped pieces and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the baklava from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the baklava warm, garnished with a sprinkle of salt.
